body:
Adds Neon Coil as a separate game alongside the existing grid Snake. The thin, curved player snake follows pointer movement without a click; touch drag and keyboard steering are also supported. Eighteen named local bots seek food, grow, collide, die and leave collectible trails. Boost spends earned mass, the ranking uses live snake mass, and pause, restart, saved continuation and offline play use the existing arcade shell.

The arena uses original artwork and clearly identifies its local bots. Existing Snake, Pool and Study implementation sources, ads, workflows and deployment configuration are untouched. Shared catalog integration adds the fourteenth game and updates catalog-count assertions.

Astra's final exact-checkpoint review found no remaining findings at runtime commit `9e187e8a23c5df263092dc27ec3b7b6ac5ad837f`; head `1e08484b890bb2d60ced32989bfc139d075acc44` adds review documentation and evidence only. Local validation passed 288 unit/core tests, 16 Chromium cases, strict TypeScript, build and production offline checks at both paths. Chromium cases cover both touch orders, control hit-testing after rotation, collisions/death food, boost, pause, save/restore, restart and disposal. Full repository CI is requested on this draft PR; its terminal result will be recorded separately.

[Verification history and limitations](src/games/neon-coil/TEST_RESULTS.md) · [Final independent audit](docs/evidence/neon-coil/review-final/astra/REVIEW.md) · [Interaction recording](docs/evidence/neon-coil/mouse-boost-pause.webm)

Local WebKit installation was unavailable after HTTP 403; CI must establish Chromium/WebKit coverage. Physical device/trackpad testing and reference PDF/video fidelity are not claimed. The original negative reviews, failed runs and slower software-rendering measurements are retained. This draft is for review and CI only; no merge, release or deployment is requested.
title: Add Neon Coil continuous local snake arena
